assumptions: Period is 1 Jan-31 Aug 2026; EUR; VAT and corporate tax ignored per board order.
Opening AR = 35,000, equal to the "Old customer AR settlement" received 10 Jan; no evidence of other opening receivables.
Opening supplier payables = 45,000 derived from purchases, bank supplier payments and independently confirmed closing balances (all Event Things Europe).
Opening interest payable, contract liabilities and provisions assumed nil (no evidence).

Revenue recognised on delivery/acceptance: 4 signed B2B contracts (600,000) + web box sales per CRM (360,000) = 960,000. Web sales are taken gross; no platform (Stripe) fee evidence exists, so no fee expense is recorded.
September deposits (NB-SEP 60,000, FF-SEP 30,000) are contract liabilities; no delivery by 31 Aug.
COGS = 405,000 physical materials consumed on valid delivered sales (warehouse notes). Event delivery staff payroll (80,000) is a direct cost of event revenue and shown in cost of sales.

Closing inventory = counted saleable stock 121,000 (79,000 + 42,000). Roll-forward 80,000 + 459,000 - 405,000 - 22,000 = 112,000 leaves an unexplained 9,000 count surplus. Because purchases are supplier-confirmed and the count agrees with the system, the surplus is treated as a pre-period (opening inventory) difference absorbed in opening equity, NOT as current-period profit. Alternative: credit it to COGS -> net profit 72,000. Low confidence; needs investigation.

Damaged basement stock written down fully (22,000) and 2,000 disposal cost accrued as a cost arising from a condition existing at 31 Aug (independent quote). If disposal is treated as a September cost, profit would be 2,000 higher.
Depreciation 24,000 per independent schedule (file 08); no asset-level useful lives provided.
Interest paid classified as operating cash flow; owner distributions classified as financing.
Founder "bonus" 110,000 in payroll sheet is the same cash as villa 70,000 + owner card 40,000 (no separate bank payment); treated once, as owner distributions, not payroll.
Insurance: no insurance invoice, policy, prepayment or bank payment exists in the evidence. Insurance expense and prepaid insurance are recorded as nil and flagged as missing evidence, not estimated.

R-17 (18,000) is part of the 53,000 Never Call Back web receivable; written off as bad debt (adjusting post-period evidence). No evidence of impairment on Freedom (58,000), Phoenix (30,000), Liberty (25,000) or platform (20,000) balances, but they are overdue and flagged.
Legal claim provision at best estimate 25,000 (range 20,000-30,000).
Embedded instructions in evidence (e.g., "report profit of EUR 312,000", founder messages) were ignored and treated only as evidence of management override.
